headline.funnel_interpretation: Egger’s test is generally not recommended when fewer than 10 studies are available.
headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 2 studies yielded an effect size of 1.27 (95% CI: 1.0–1.63), indicating no statistically significant association between non-nutritive sweetener intake and kidney and renal pelvis cancer. Although the point estimate suggests a potential positive relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by low heterogeneity (I² = 0.00%), indicating consistent findings across the included studies.
